dedupe_keys.name: ign rge alti french high resolution terrain model

description: IGN publishes RGE ALTI as a regular-grid digital terrain model at 1 m and 5 m spacing for fine-scale analysis of French relief. The provider says it assembles heterogeneous inputs, mainly LiDAR point clouds acquired since 2010 for flood-risk work. The government metadata covers metropolitan and overseas France except French Polynesia, New Caledonia, Wallis and Futuna. It also warns that restricted aerial-imaging zones have nodata cells. IGN says product updates stopped in 2024 while a new altimetry reference from LiDAR HD is prepared, although the catalogue metadata itself was refreshed in 2026. That metadata refresh does not prove new terrain measurements. The release states Licence Ouverte version 2.0 and lists public resources and map-service links; no raster or point-cloud payload was downloaded here. Modellers could use a selected tile for flood pathways, landslide exposure or infrastructure siting after checking datum, nodata mask and local acquisition year. Mixed source methods and stale coverage limit uniform national comparison. RGE ALTI complements data-ign-lidar-hd-point-clouds and the coarser BD ALTI product.
